subject: general
question:
Fill in the blank with suitable tense.

People will consider everything before they _______.
solution:
The correct answer is **'vote'.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

 
• **'before' ** is used as a **subordinating conjunction.** 
 
• When the **main clause** includes **modal,** the verb in the **subordinating clause** remains in **Present Tense.**
 
 
• **Example: **We will finish the work** before** he arrives.
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct answer is** option 4.**

 

**Correct Sentence: ***People will consider everything before they vote.*
